toy_check: 站得住：纸缘短足着地。物件长进去：橡皮就是头，纸就是身体。特殊材质只有浅粉橡皮。新组合：只擦一截、纸还在的橡皮人。不像绘本。头像可见橡皮头。做得成。姿态：微前倾，不是用力擦。

zh: 原创潮玩角色，一片墨灰短绒扁纸身和一块圆角长橡皮长在一起：橡皮就是它的头，纸就是它的身体，拿掉橡皮就没有角色。头是一块略宽于肩的横宽橡皮，几乎没有颈，纸身下缘分成两枚短钝足。半垂小黑豆眼贴在橡皮中下部，眼距略宽，极小一字嘴，视线落下。它站稳，身体微微前倾，只留下一截浅米擦痕，底下的纸没有被擦穿。主体是墨灰短绒，只有头是软质浅粉橡皮。配色是浅粉配墨灰，加一点浅米擦痕。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要把橡皮画成手里的文具，不要把纸擦穿，不要满地碎屑，不要写字和作业本格子，不要品牌橡皮字样。
enp: Original designer toy character: a ink-grey plush sheet-body fused with a rounded oblong eraser — the eraser is the head and the sheet is the body, without the eraser there is no character. The head is a wide eraser slightly broader than the shoulders, almost no neck, the lower edge of the sheet splits into two short blunt feet. Half-lidded tiny black bean eyes sit on the lower mid-eraser, slightly wide-set, a tiny straight mouth, gaze lowered. It stands, body tilted a little forward, only a short cream rub mark left, the sheet not worn through. Body is ink-grey plush; only the head is soft pale-pink eraser. Colors: pale pink with ink grey and a cream rub accent. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No handheld eraser, no sheet worn through, no crumbs everywhere, no writing or notebook lines, no branded eraser lettering.
